analytical_dimensions.description: Processes and dated events Before making an interval or a sequence, identify the same event or instrument by its explicit name and an identity predicate in the source. Nearby dates about related laws, proposals or programs do not establish successive stages of one instrument. Keep separately named instruments in separate event rows unless the text explicitly links their identity. Two dated endpoints alone do not establish continuous activity between them. Mark the intervening activity unknown unless the source states duration. Recompute every overlap/intersection table from the retained supported intervals; remove all relations derived from an unsupported interval. Distinguish an article's publication/reference year from the date of the reported event.
probing_questions: What was happening simultaneously, and how do different timelines overlap or contradict?
